title: ee.focus.suggest.v1
description: Read-only recommendation surface for `ee focus suggest` (bd-sg5si Phase 1; bd-1idcb Phase 2). Returns the topics, CASS spans, and pre-formatted follow-up queries an agent should pivot attention toward, ranked by `centrality_sum + recency_weight + span_density` over the recent-evidence window. The schema is stable across Phase 1 and Phase 2; the `recommendations` array is populated when the workspace has memories created within `recentHours`. `degraded[]` carries situation-appropriate entries (e.g. `graph_unavailable`, `no_recent_evidence`) only when a real signal is missing — the Phase 1 `focus_suggest_unimplemented` sentinel was retired by Phase 2.

recommendations.description: Ranked focus recommendations. Empty in Phase 1; populated by the centrality + recent-CASS scoring pipeline in Phase 2.

topic.description: Short topic label summarizing what the agent should focus on next.

spanIds.description: CASS span IDs attached to memories in this cluster within the recency window. Populated only when `fromCass` is true AND matching evidence_spans exist; may be empty otherwise. Entries are deduplicated and sorted lexically.

centralityScore.description: Graph centrality contribution to the rank. Higher is more central; absolute scale is implementation-dependent.

rationale.description: Why this topic surfaced. Cites the centrality signal and the recent-CASS evidence.

suggestedQuery.description: Concrete ee command (typically `ee pack` or `ee search`) the agent can run to act on the recommendation. New recommendations emit `ee pack` (the canonical post-triad-promotion surface); the soft-deprecated `ee context` alias is intentionally avoided so agents acting on a recommendation do not immediately trip the `deprecated_alias` degraded entry.

fromCass.description: True when the recommendations were derived from CASS evidence; false when only the durable memory graph contributed.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations the response may return. Mirrors `--limit` (default 5).

recentHours.description: Look-back window in hours for the recent-CASS evidence. Mirrors `--recent-hours` (default 24).

recommendations.rationale: PageRank dominator over the last 24h of CASS evidence; six bead closures cite this topic.
